versions.changelog:
- Added new dependency: p-video-2-pro-reference, expanding the available video generation tools.
- Updated internal version to 1.0.15.
- Removed skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.
- No changes to user-facing functionality or commands.

pruna 1.0.14

- Updated SKILL.md metadata to version 1.0.14.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added new dependency: p-video-2-pro (for cinematic clip generation).
- Updated dependencies list and tool descriptions to include p-video-2-pro and clarify roles for p-video-2 and p-video.
- Bumped version to 1.0.13.
- Removed the file: skill-card.md.

- Added new dependency: p-video-2, providing a higher-quality video generation tool.
- Updated tool descriptions in SKILL.md to clarify when to use p-video-2 vs. p-video.
- Removed the unused skill-card.md file.
- Incremented skill version to 1.0.12.

- Version updated to 1.0.11.
- Added new dependency: `p-video-edit`.
- Expanded "Tools" section to include `p-video-edit`, describing its use for editing existing videos via text instructions.
- Removed `skill-card.md` file.

- Bumped version to 1.0.10.
- Updated SKILL.md metadata for the new version.
- Removed the file skill-card.md.

- Added new tool: `p-image-ideogram` for photoreal image generation, in-image text, and advanced control.
- Updated dependencies to reflect the addition of `p-image-ideogram`.
- Improved tool descriptions, clarifying when to use `p-image` vs. `p-image-ideogram`.
- Removed `branding` skill from the dependency list and documentation.
- Removed the legacy `skill-card.md` file.

- Added the new `branding` guide skill for Pruna brand assets and overlay rules.
- Updated dependencies in SKILL.md to include `branding`.
- Removed outdated skill-card.md file.

- Added comprehensive skill suite for Pruna generative media, bundling all guides, tools, and workflows in one install.
- Includes step-by-step guides for image, video, and audio prompting, as well as video editing and API usage.
- Provides ready-to-use tools for fast AI image, video, and audio generation, editing, upscaling, narration, and music.
- Features advanced workflows for narrated scenes, multi-scene videos, explainer content, music videos, and illustrated story reels.
- Centralizes installation and documentation, with clear requirements and recommended reading order for maximum effectiveness.
